shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], name [sync_match_prompts] at the same time. Different answers and you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A] and [Player B], name [sync_dodge_prompts] at the same time. Say the same thing and you each take [Penalty, 2].
Everyone shout [sync_mid] at the same time. If nobody matches, everyone takes [Penalty, 1].
Everyone shout [sync_large] at the same time. If nobody matches, everyone takes [Penalty, 1].
[Player A] and [Player B], say any word at the same time. Keep going with a word that links the last two until you match. Every miss after the first round, you each take [Penalty, 1].
[Player A] and [Player B], think of [wavelength_seeds]. Blurt the first word that comes to mind at the same time. Match in two tries or you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A] and [Player B], together you must [coop_tasks]. Pull it off and you're both safe. Fail and you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A] and [Player B], you have [Timer, 30] to [coop_tasks_timed] together. Beat the clock and you're both safe. Run out and you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A] and [Player B], take turns naming words that rhyme with '[rhyme_starters]'. Get 8 in [Timer, 25] or you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A] and [Player B], [coop_tasks_sabotage] while everyone else tries to throw you off. Mess up and you each take [Penalty, 2]. Pull it off and everyone else does.

As a group, count out loud to 20 in [Timer, 90]. No order, no plan, one number per person at a time. If two people speak at once, everyone takes [Penalty, 1] and starts over. If time runs out, everyone takes [Penalty, 2].
[Player A], you lead. [Player B], mirror everything [Player A] does for [Timer, 20]. Fall out of sync and you take [Penalty, 2-3].
[Player A], make a sound. Everyone echoes it back together. If the echo falls apart, everyone takes [Penalty, 1-2].
Everyone talk about [contraband_topics] for [Timer, 30] without saying "[banned_words]". If anyone slips, everyone takes [Penalty, 1].
Everyone [group_actions] at the exact same time. If you aren't in sync, everyone takes [Penalty, 1].
[Player A], close your eyes. [Player B], using only your voice, talk [Player A] through [blind_lead_tasks] in [Timer, 30]. Mess up or run out of time and you each take [Penalty, 2].
[Player A], check the secret and give [Player B] one-word clues without using part of the answer. Crack it in [Timer, 20] and everyone else takes [Penalty, 2]. If not, you each take them.

[Player A], check the secret and give [Player B] clues without using part of the password or any restricted words. Crack it in [Timer, 30] and everyone else takes [Penalty, 2]. Run out of time or mess up and you each take them instead.

secret_text.default: [Player A], the password is '[password_restricted.a]'. The restricted words are [password_restricted.b].

reveal_text.default: The password was '[password_restricted.a]'. The restricted words were [password_restricted.b].

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret and give one-word clues without using part of the answer. First to guess it in [Timer, 20] gives out [Penalty, 2-3]. If nobody does, you take them.

secret_text.default: [Player A], get the group to say '[password_words]'.

shell_text.default: [Player A], check the secret and give [Player B] one-word clues to the password. Crack it in [Timer, 30] and everyone else takes [Penalty, 3]. If not, you each take them. If [Player B] says the trap word, you each take [Penalty, max] instead.

secret_text.default: [Player A], get [Player B] to say '[password_trap_words.a]'. The trap word is '[password_trap_words.b]'.

reveal_text.default: The password was '[password_trap_words.a]'. The trap word was '[password_trap_words.b]'.

shell_text.default: [Player A] and [Player B], [coop_poses]. Hold it for [Timer, 15-30]. If either of you breaks, you each take [Penalty, 2-3].
Everyone throw out 1 to 5 fingers at the same time. Everyone who threw the most common number(s) takes [Penalty, 2-3]. If nobody matched, you're all safe.
Everyone throw out 1 to 5 fingers at the same time. The highest unique number gives out [Penalty, 3]. If there isn't one, go again.
Everyone throw out 1 to 10 fingers at the same time. The highest unique number gives out [Penalty, 3]. If there isn't one, go again.
[Player A], whisper a deal to [Player B]. If they refuse to shake on it, you both take [Penalty, 3].
